blurb: Santa Barbara Dance Arts offers dance classes from babies and toddlers through adults, focusing on personal growth, socialization, and dance skills. They provide flexible monthly payment programs, placement for advanced classes, and multiple pathways for leadership and success. The studio is ADA friendly and committed to inclusivity and accessibility.
